rows.name_as_written: Cooperative Health Research in the Region of Augsburg (KORA) S4
rows.quote: The discovery sample was derived from the population-based KORA S4 cohort study comprising 4261 participants at baseline (1999 to 2001) [18].
rows.coder_note: Outcome data are the individual-level cohort itself (incident events in the discovery cohort), named in the sentence; the dictionary has no row for it.

rows.quote: For validation, data from the KORA-Age1 study was used.
rows.coder_note: Outcome data are the individual-level validation cohort named in the sentence; the dictionary has no row for it.
